BiblicalUsage: The law came four hundred and thirty years after the covenant confirmed in Christ, and the man at the pool had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the numbers are kept exactly because the promises are kept exactly: four hundred and thirty years did not annul the covenant.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
